name: Bodyweight squat ladder
description: Climb from easy squats to tempo squats.

name: Goblet squat tempo
description: Slow squats with a pause at the bottom.

name: Heavy back squat
description: Work up to a challenging set of squats.
caution: Heavy squats load the knees and lower back. Use safety bars, warm up well, and stop if you feel sharp pain.

name: Tempo squats and lunges
description: A steady, controlled set to wake your legs up.
caution: Keep your knees tracking over your toes. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.

name: Gentle glute bridges
description: Easy bridges with a steady squeeze at the top.

name: Walking lunges
description: Walk forward through lunges at a relaxed pace.

name: Romanian deadlift control
description: Slow hinges with a flat back and a soft knee.

name: Jump squat burst
description: Short, explosive jump squats with rest between sets.
caution: Jumping loads the knees and ankles. Land softly and stop if you feel joint pain.

name: Wall sit hold
description: Hold a wall sit for short intervals, breathing slowly.

name: Step-up flow
description: Smooth step-ups at an easy, steady pace.

name: Bulgarian split squat
description: Balanced, controlled split squats on each side.

name: Leg press easy
description: Light presses in a comfortable range.

name: Sprint-and-squat circuit
caution: Sprints stress the legs. Warm up and stop if you feel sharp muscle or joint pain.
